ingredients_raw: Potato, edible vegetable oil (palmolein, cotton seed, corn, sunflower), refined sugar, iodised salt, dehydrated vegetable (tomato (0.8%), onion, garlic), spices & condiments (chilli, black pepper, cumin, clove, cinnamon, ginger), acidity regulator (INS 296, INS 330), hydrolysed vegetable protein (soy), anticaking agent (INS 551), flavour enhancer (INS 627, INS 631), natural flavouring substances & nature identical flavouring substances.
